cues.text: [Low strings and drums. A window bangs open; the wind tears a page from an old tome.]
[The page sails into a scriptorium as a tower of scrolls collapses.]
[A hooded hero strides through the falling paper and catches the page.]
[He wakes a sleeping council by slamming the page on the table. It is a map.]
[Dawn. Map in hand, he heads down a hilltop towards Budapest.]
[He plants a flag, and a mountain of scrolls sorts itself into ordered stacks.]
[Before rows of students, he lights three rings over the stage.]
[The dragon seals the deal with a wax stamp, in a burst of sparks.]
[Night by the Danube. He drops the cloak.]
[Footsteps on wet stone: he runs in black kit, the Chain Bridge behind him.]
